facts.text: The house was built for the Crawford family in 1912.
facts.excerpt: Built for the Crawford family in 1912, the property has changed hands several times

facts.excerpt: with former lives as a country club, an Orient-Express hotel, and the home of Sir Bernard Ashley—husband and business partner of designer Laura Ashley.

facts.text: Original fireplaces were restored where possible, as were the intricate millwork and crown molding.

facts.text: The most recent renovation took nearly four years and wrapped in October 2021.

facts.text: The resort was completely updated in 2020.

facts.text: The resort has an infinity pool.
facts.excerpt: from the sprawling Pete Dye–designed golf course to the infinity pool that wouldn’t be out of place in the Caribbean.

facts.text: Rooms and suites are adorned in light woods, timeless furnishings and locally inspired photography, with Duxiana mattresses and Red Flower bathroom amenities.
facts.excerpt: Adorned in light woods, timeless furnishings, and locally-inspired photography, our hotel rooms & suites in Charlottesville, VA feature luxurious Duxiana mattresses and bespoke Red Flower bathroom amenities.

facts.text: Rooms have Frette sheets and bath linens.
facts.excerpt: Elegant Frette sheets and bath linens

facts.text: Many rooms have private terraces that overlook the golf course.
facts.excerpt: Many rooms have private terraces that overlook the golf course.

facts.text: The minibar in each room includes complimentary snacks and drinks.

facts.text: Room layouts and furniture differ a great deal, so guests who want a desk or a walk-in closet should request it when booking.
facts.excerpt: The room layouts and furniture differ immensely, so if you prefer a desk to work at or a walk-in closet with plenty of storage space or both, be sure to request it when booking.

facts.text: The spa sits at the edge of woodland, with soft interior lighting and natural finishes.
facts.excerpt: Nestled into the edge of woodland and featuring soft interior lighting and natural finishes, the spa’s design encourages tranquility and recovery.

facts.text: The spa's serenity room offers weighted blankets, guided meditation tools and freshly steeped herbal teas.
facts.excerpt: A serenity room offers weighted blankets, guided meditation tools and freshly steeped herbal teas.

facts.text: The spa's treatment rooms accommodate couples' services, massages, body treatments and facials, and hair and nail services are offered in its salon.
facts.excerpt: Eight beautifully appointed treatment rooms accommodate couples’ services, massages, body treatments and facials. Hair and nail services are available in our stylish salon
